quote: Empirical results on six tasks—including multiturn conversation, code generation, and mathematical reasoning—across three LLM families (Llama 2, Llama 3) with model sizes ranging from 7B to 70B demonstrate that SPECTRA outperforms other non-training speculative decoding methods.

We conduct comprehensive evaluations on various generation tasks. MT-Bench for multi-turn conversation; GSM8K for mathematical reasoning; HumanEval, MBPP and ClassEval for code generation; and we also evaluate on CNN/DailyMail and XSum summarization datasets.

SPECTRA Decoding produces ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores on both the CNN/DailyMail and XSum summarization datasets that are nearly identical to those of standard autoregressive sampling.
